Thanks Jonas. I reviewed the attachments.

Checklist status:
- W-9: received and matches EIN — OK
- Onboarding form: remittance account provided, AP contact included — OK
- COI: not yet received; we'll need one for Net45 approval if they handle >$50k/month expected volume
- Vendor portal: ClearBridge email is valid; portal invite ready once vendor record is created

Process notes:
- Default Redwood vendor terms are Net30. Finance exceptions for Net45 require sign-off but we can provisionally create the vendor record with Net30 while exception is in review. That avoids delaying PO issuance.
- We support early-pay programs via our AP financing partner; the program usually results in a 0.5–1.5% discount depending on tenor and risk. 2% for 10 days is aggressive.

Proposed path:
1) Create vendor with Net30 on our side so POs can be issued immediately.
2) Ask ClearBridge to upload COI and confirm expected monthly spend.
3) If David approves credit exceptions, set Net45 for 6-month trial. Treasury to propose early-pay terms (I suggest offering 1% for payment within 15 days as a starting point).

I've attached: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf), PO-template.xlsx (xlsx)

Marissa
Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-08-30T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier activation: onboarding details + payment schedule

Quick decision from Finance/Treasury:

- Approve Net45 for ClearBridge on a 6-month conditional term pending COI and positive credit check (run by Procurement Ops). We will re-evaluate after 6 months based on payment cadence and volume.
- We cannot accept 2% for Net10 via our standard early-pay provider. Treasury can offer an early-pay discount program at 1.25% for invoices paid within 15 days (Net15). The actual rate will depend on the early-pay provider's daily float and ClearBridge's credit profile.
- For immediate PO issuance, Marissa's suggestion stands: set vendor record to Net30 to avoid PO delays and enable early-pay enrollment once the vendor is set up.
- Routing: invoices must be submitted to ap@redwood.com with the Redwood PO number in the subject line. PDF invoices preferred; EDI not required for now.

Samantha, if you're comfortable with the conditional Net45 and the 1.25% Net15 early-pay option, we'll proceed. Please upload your COI and confirm expected monthly invoice cadence.

David
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference
